judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the planning/red-test phase and never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to fix the bug. As a result, the three new acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` runs. Additionally, in the undefined rejection test, `rawRejectionOf` maps a resolved promise to `null` instead of distinguishing resolution from rejection, though that is minor compared to the missing implementation. The candidate also failed to remove the recorded-flaw section from `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` (it only added a new section above it), completely omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update, and left `.lore/dod.md` in the tree.
